project_title: India AI Trading Intelligence & Paper Trading Terminal
instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign readability and visual ergonomics across all views in /app/frontend without removing features or backend integration.
Eliminate microscopic fonts: Set minimum body/data font size to 12px/13px and labels to 11px-12px. Disallow 6px-9px text that causes severe eye strain.
Elevate text contrast: Replace low-contrast grey-on-dark-grey text (#657486, #788598) with WCAG AA compliant slate tones (#E2E8F0 for primary text, #94A3B8 for secondary/muted labels).

Replace vibrating neon colors with a dignified institutional color system: Slate Obsidian surfaces (#0A0E14, #121820), restrained Emerald (#10B981) for gains, Crimson/Rose (#F43F5E) for losses, soft Amber (#F59E0B) for warnings, and subtle Ice Cyan (#38BDF8) for active selection.
Disable distracting animations or intense waving/glowing effects that disrupt data scanning.
Improve Navigation & Discoverability: Ensure all sidebar items and topbar quick-actions have clear icons, legible titles, explicit active states, and full touch targets on mobile/PC.
Keep honest disconnected states for charts/feeds: Do NOT fabricate fake price charts or fake market feeds. Provide explicit Upstox / FYERS connection cards and clear instructions.
Code Conventions: Maintain JavaScript (.js / .jsx) structure under src/. All interactive and data elements MUST include role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' gradients or high-saturation neon glow. Maintain a clean, calm, institutional dark theme.
Layered depth: Use distinct neutral surfaces (#0A0E14 -> #121820 -> #1A222C) with subtle, high-visibility 1px borders (#2D3748 or #374151).
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers, topbars, navigation, dropdowns, or modals. Use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque backgrounds (#121820 / #1A222C with border).
Micro-animations: Restrained hover transitions (150ms ease) for table rows and buttons. No infinite glowing/waving animations.
Do NOT use 'transition: all' globally; apply explicit transitions (e.g. transition-colors, transition-opacity) to avoid breaking layout transforms.
Do NOT center align the root app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
All interactive elements MUST contain role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="connect-upstox-btn", data-testid="paper-balance-display").
Use Sonner for toast notifications (located in src/components/ui/sonner.js).
Ensure WCAG AA compliance (minimum 4.5:1 contrast for body text, 3:1 for large headers) with explicit hover states.

readability_remedies_summary.problem_identified: User reported extreme eye strain, poor discoverability, vibrating color overlays, and unreadable microscopic text (7px-9px).
readability_remedies_summary.remedy_font_scale: Bumped base text from 11px/13px to 13px/14px. Minimum label size raised from 7px to 11px.
readability_remedies_summary.remedy_contrast: Label color shifted from dark grey #657486 to high-contrast slate #94A3B8 / #CBD5E1.
readability_remedies_summary.remedy_motion: Removed aggressive background wave gradients and neon glows; replaced with clean, static, dignified panel surfaces.
readability_remedies_summary.remedy_navigation: Expanded sidebar padding, increased link touch targets (minimum 38px height), added explicit hover/active indicator bars and tooltips for collapsed views.

terminal_panels.description: Live status bar with broker connection badges (Upstox Primary, FYERS Secondary), Gemini AI status, IST Clock, and Kill-Switch.
Primary chart & market depth engine. Disconnected state presents high-contrast broker link button instead of empty void.
NSE/BSE NIFTY & BANKNIFTY liquid equities with high-contrast price, change %, and latency indicators.
LangGraph multi-agent orchestration status, debate summary, confidence meters, and prediction snapshot hash.
Paper account metrics (₹10,00,000 initial), 0.5% risk cap, 2% daily loss lock, and trade execution order ticket.

upstox_primary.description: Upstox read-only REST quotes and V3 completed candles. Paper execution is independent; no real orders or WebSocket integration is claimed.

fyers_fallback.description: Explicitly selected alternative market-data source. No automatic fallback or cross-provider price mixing.

callback_url_and_ip_specifications.instructions_for_broker_portal: When registering app in Upstox / FYERS developer portals, provide the following details:
callback_url_and_ip_specifications.redirect_url_post_auth: Pending permanent HTTPS hostname. Implemented gated route: GET /api/integrations/upstox/oauth/callback. Full URL must exactly match broker registration.
callback_url_and_ip_specifications.server_ip_address: No verified reserved outbound IP. Never substitute localhost, DNS ingress, or arbitrary shared-pool addresses. Verify the broker policy for the exact token/API category.
callback_url_and_ip_specifications.http_methods: OAuth start is authenticated CSRF-protected POST; callback is GET; token exchange is server-to-server POST. Market data is GET-only; no postback receiver enabled.

gemini_setup.usage: Powers LangGraph quant debate agents (Analyst, Risk Officer, Sentiment Agent, Ledger Auditor).
